The runtime enumerator gates candidate groups by feature exactly as the Python enumerator does, so a non-seed record never forms a fresh group — it only ever joins a curated group. Items carry provenance so the TS mirror applies the provenance gate itself; `cap` is the exact tier_b_view cap over the full entry; `uo` is the N1 untaps-other self-scope guard. Pure function of the KB corpus + the committed matcher index.
